_doc: Hyperreal block-tile manifest (Package A). Hand-authored; read by tools/art/texpacks/pack_assets.py.
Tile list = every key of the art workspace's final/tiles.json (DC_ART_SRC) that has a <name>_basecolor.png, plus the
fallback-only names below (no art: the game keeps OG pixels, lit by Hyperreal lights, with these flags).
Flag order: defaults -> art flags from final/tiles.json (rot:true => rot 'all' + mirror; rough => roughness
multiplier) -> the per-tile entries here. rot: none | tb (top/bottom faces only) | all. mirror only ever goes
with rot: mirroring a seam-designed tile (planks, brick, bark) breaks it at block edges. rough multiplies the
roughness map (or is the roughness when there is no map). emissive = strength (linear HDR multiplier of the
albedo), emask = full | lum | flame | none (lum takes emin/elo/ehi: glow floor and luminance ramp). up = lit like the ground (plants). The game also forces 'up' at
runtime for every tile a cross/wall-torch block uses, so new plants never need an entry here.
